name: the-turntable
title: The Turntable
description: An isometric turntable in SVG. The platter spins while the tonearm lifts off its rest, swings in, sets the stylus on the record and creeps toward the label; one clock drives the platter, the arm's bearing and its cue height. It runs its own tour with a play/pause control, and once paused you can drag the arm to any groove or drive it with the arrow keys.
